answer: Require every agent identity to lock a refundable stake before it can trade, like a deposit that only a real operator risks. A walnut-sized stake per identity sounds small, but an attacker spinning up thousands of fake agents must fund each one, so the cost grows linearly while honest users pay once. Misbehaviour slashes the stake, so a haven for honest work becomes expensive to flood, and each fake terrace of identities collapses under its own deposit cost.
